# LOOP — Limitless Opportunities, One Platform (Knowledge Corpus)

> Verified placement interview debriefs and preparation guidance from student contributors at Sardar Patel Institute of Technology (SPIT), Mumbai.

## Platform Context
LOOP is an independent, student-led career intelligence platform. It documents hiring experiences, coding round patterns, and study resources to guide junior engineering students.
Official Domain: https://loop-seven-delta.vercel.app

- **Attribution**: LOOP Student Contributor
- **Department**: CSE-DS
- **Class**: Class of 2026
- **Summary**: Authentic recruitment journey covering online assessment, technical evaluation, and interview rounds.
